name: Chaos Baby Yoshimi ~Takase Haruna Hen~
original_name: カオスBaby義美 ～高瀬春奈編～
source:
Shinichi barely escaped from slavery of Queen Ryoko. Now he lives in the house of Ryoko's sister Misuzu and attends the school where Ryoko's nice Yoshimi is studying. And Yoshimi does have a difficult character as well.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-december-2000-never7-end-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
真一好不容易才逃离辽子女王的奴役。如今，他住在辽子的姐姐美铃家中，并在辽子的侄女义美就读的学校上学。然而，义美的性格同样十分难以应付。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-december-2000-never7-end-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
